description: Get benefit deadlines, credit resets, fee renewals, and expiry windows as structured calendar-ready event objects. Use this to intelligently create, skip, or customize calendar reminders based on the user's actual schedule.

end_date.description: End of date range in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: start_date + 30 days)

event_types.description: Filter by event type (default: all types)

include_used.description: Include events for benefits already marked used (default: false)

start_date.description: Start of date range in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

name: get_calendar_events
